# Microwave Toolbox Sync Tree

## Purpose

This document tracks how ALUs components relate to the legacy S1TBX code layout and the current SNAP Microwave Toolbox layout. It is a working sync tree for reviewing which upstream Microwave Toolbox changes may need to be considered for ALUs upgrades.

The scope is provenance and traceability. Prioritisation, benchmark framing, and discussion context are covered in [`s1tbx-microwave-toolbox-upgrade-abstract.md`](s1tbx-microwave-toolbox-upgrade-abstract.md).

## Interpretation

In this document, `S1TBX` means the legacy source layout and naming used when most ALUs ports were developed. `Microwave Toolbox` means the active successor repository and the relevant target for current benchmark comparison.

ALUs is not synchronized with one exact upstream S1TBX commit. It is a component-wise native port assembled over time from S1TBX/SNAP logic, with selected behavior reimplemented in C++ and CUDA. Therefore, sync review must be performed per component and, where needed, per method.

## Top-Level Sync Tree

```text
ALUs
├── sentinel1/
│   ├── s1tbx-commons/              -> s1tbx-commons -> sar-commons
│   ├── s1tbx-io/                   -> s1tbx-io -> sar-io
│   ├── io/orbits/                  -> s1tbx-io-ephemeris -> sar-io-ephemeris
│   └── jlinda/                     -> jlinda -> jlinda
├── snap-engine/                    -> snap-engine -> snap-engine
├── algs/apply-orbit-file-op/       -> ApplyOrbitFileOp -> ApplyOrbitFileOp
├── algs/sentinel1-calibrate/       -> Sentinel1Calibrator / CalibrationOp -> Sentinel1Calibrator / CalibrationOp
├── algs/thermal-noise-removal/     -> Sentinel1RemoveThermalNoiseOp -> Sentinel1RemoveThermalNoiseOp
├── algs/backgeocoding/             -> BackGeocodingOp -> BackGeocodingOp
├── algs/coherence-cuda/            -> CoherenceOp -> CoherenceOp
├── algs/topsar-split/              -> TOPSARSplitOp -> TOPSARSplitOp
├── algs/topsar-deburst-op/         -> TOPSARDeburstOp -> TOPSARDeburstOp
├── algs/topsar-merge/              -> TOPSARMergeOp -> TOPSARMergeOp
└── algs/range-doppler-terrain-correction/
    └── RangeDopplerGeocodingOp     -> RangeDopplerGeocodingOp
```

## Module Rename Map

| Legacy S1TBX module | Current Microwave Toolbox module | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `s1tbx-commons` | `sar-commons` | Common SAR helpers, Sentinel-1 utilities, SAR geocoding, orbit-state-vector helpers |
| `s1tbx-io` | `sar-io` | SAR product readers, Sentinel-1 SAFE reader, GeoTIFF/XML handling |
| `s1tbx-io-ephemeris` | `sar-io-ephemeris` | Orbit-file readers and Apply-Orbit-File operator |
| `s1tbx-op-calibration` | `sar-op-calibration` | Calibration, thermal noise removal, calibration support classes |
| `s1tbx-op-insar` | `sar-op-insar` | Coherence, interferogram, coregistration helpers, InSAR operators |
| `s1tbx-op-sentinel1` | `sar-op-sentinel1` | TOPSAR split/deburst/merge, backgeocoding, Sentinel-1-specific operators |
| `s1tbx-op-sar-processing` | `sar-op-sar-processing` | Range-Doppler geocoding, terrain correction, SAR geometric processing |
| `org.esa.s1tbx.*` | `eu.esa.sar.*` | Java package namespace migration |

## Sync Review Fields

When a component is reviewed, use the following fields to make the result actionable.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ALUs component | Path and function/class under review |
| Upstream component | Current Microwave Toolbox Java class/method or SNAP Engine class/method |
| Legacy source clue | Comment, test, ALUs commit, or S1TBX-era class used to identify lineage |
| Change type | Numerical, metadata, product support, default parameter, performance-only, refactor-only |
| Quality impact | Expected effect on calibration, coherence, coregistration, geolocation, or no-data behavior |
| Benchmark impact | Whether latest Microwave Toolbox benchmark output may differ because of this change |
| ALUs action | No action, verify with tests, port logic, document divergence, or out of scope |
| Test evidence | Dataset, command/graph, output metric, or unit/integration test proving decision |

Thermal-noise verification note: the reported `S1A_IW_GRDH_1SDV_20230702T034804_20230702T034833_049239_05EBBE_15A6.SAFE` failure completes with the Microwave Toolbox IW2 fallback to range vector 2. The Virumaa calibration output remains pixel-identical to its golden. The changed S1D output from `build-automation/estonia-2026-S1D-calibration.sh` has been manually verified and accepted.

Range-Doppler geocoding note: `ReaderUtils::CreateFineTiePointGrid()` is not discarded from review. ALUs Range-Doppler terrain correction can consume product latitude/longitude tie-point grids, and ALUs had a C++ port-specific output-vector pass-by-value issue in this helper path. The STEP forum report [Geolocation inaccuracy](https://forum.step.esa.int/t/geolocation-inaccuracy/37504) is tracked as Range-Doppler/TOPSAR subset-size geolocation evidence, not as proof that `CreateFineTiePointGrid()` alone caused the upstream issue.
